original.statement: Flux adds three new CLI subcommands for image policy operations: flux [reconcile|suspend|resume] image policy.

decision.reason: [ev-7eb7fed1368f] says new CLI subcommands were added (`flux reconcile image policy`, `flux suspend image policy`, `flux resume image policy`). It does not mention any command-line flag. The cli-flag family only covers flags, and its name must start with --. The proposed name also puts three commands into one string and includes the product name, which is not allowed. That makes the subject wrong, and no subject family in the vocabulary fits a CLI subcommand, so the evidence gives no correct typed assertion to correct this to.
